newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Khaleda greeted by thousands on return to Dhaka.
newsitem.headline: Khaleda greeted by thousands on return to Dhaka.

text.p: Former prime minister Begum Khaleda Zia, who is facing corruption charges, was greeted by thousands of supporters on Wednesday when she returned home from Saudi Arabia after receiving medical treatment, witnesses said.
"The present government has stolen peoples' rights and is using heavy hands on the opposition," she told a large crowd of supporters at Dhaka airport.
Police on Tuesday fired teargas and chased hundreds of supporters of Khaleda's Bangladesh Nationalist Party in Dhaka after the BNP organised a rally to protest the corruption charges against Khaleda.
The Bureau of Anti-Corruption filed the charges on Sunday against Khaleda for her alleged misuse of power while in office, saying she gave police posts to several hundred members of her party.
The BNP lost an election in June to Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's Awami League.
